elements.name: User
elements.responsibility: Abstract base of all users; table users, single-table inheritance with role discriminator

elements.name: Credentials
elements.responsibility: Embedded email (unique) and password of a user

elements.name: Citizen
elements.responsibility: User who submits reports and receives notifications

elements.name: MunicipalOperator
elements.responsibility: User who handles reports, changes status, writes notes

elements.name: Report
elements.responsibility: Central entity (table reports) with current status name, category, location, owners and history

elements.name: Location
elements.responsibility: Embedded address columns of a report

elements.name: ReportCategory
elements.responsibility: Enum stored as string in reports.category

elements.name: ReportStatus
elements.responsibility: Non-persisted state interface (Submitted/Assigned/InProgress/Resolved) rebuilt from current_status

elements.name: StatusUpdate
elements.responsibility: Row per status change (table status_updates): date, new status, report, operator

elements.name: InternalNote
elements.responsibility: Operator's private note on a report (table internal_notes)

elements.name: Notification
elements.responsibility: Message to citizen on assigned/resolved status (table notifications)

elements.name: ReportService
elements.responsibility: Creates, updates and queries reports, notes, updates and notifications

elements.name: PersistenceService
elements.responsibility: Generic save/update/find over JPA EntityManager (persistence unit to MySQL)
